title: Missing pieces, holes not drilled and no assembly instructions
text: Missing pieces, holes not drilled and no assembly instructions. I needed a small file cabinet for volunteer records and paperwork and I assumed that this one would suffice. It might if there were some manufacturing quality control. However, it arrived with missing pieces, no assembly instructions at all and parts that weren't finished. Some of the holes for screws were not even drilled out.  I tried to get it together several times and the pieces just don't align properly. I'll have to just buy a pre-assembled cabinet from a local store.
